method: Independent comparison of two related-part photos, four actual Blender views, source generator and encoded colour data
findings: Local forming transitions under the head and above the eye are missing; the smooth offset function is insufficient
Eyelet needs its observed integrated annular lip, not an invented separate washer
Sinusoidal teeth are too rounded; actual angular flanks and total spline count remain undocumented
Head ears have flatter tops and more localized radii; overall blade proportions require camera calibration before global deformation
Surface remains too pastel/uniform; no normal map and no measured coating response
variant_warning: BM150 alloy/spoke catalogue differences are documented separately in front-brake-cam/research.json; current JA lever is not certified compatible with the RDC cast wheel
